name: Virtuoso Surgical
description: Virtuoso Surgical is a medical robotics company founded in 2016 in Nashville, Tennessee, USA, as a spin-out from Vanderbilt University and Johns Hopkins University. The company develops concentric-tube endoscopic robotic systems, receiving FDA De Novo marketing authorization in October 2026 for the [Virtuoso](/robot/virtuoso_virtuoso) system for transurethral en bloc bladder tumor resection.
